rule: All rows require new native evidence. Historical Windows/Android passes do not change these statuses.

cases.steps: Fresh launch; choose sample, then cancel/skip/quit; relaunch
cases.expected: No event or sample draft inserted; onboarding optional; existing users not forced through it

cases.steps: Parse the sample; choose missing duration; Confirm; restart
cases.expected: Exactly one persisted plan; real local parser used; no account or cloud key required

cases.steps: Use every time case in interaction-fixtures.json with pointer/touch and keyboard where supported
cases.expected: Exact minute and correct midnight/noon; only one full-width Confirm; original date/zone retained

cases.steps: Change wheel then Escape/Back/close; change editor then attempt dismiss
cases.expected: Canceled wheel does not mutate draft; dirty editor offers Keep editing/Discard; no silent event write

cases.steps: Change ordinary appointment start using durationCase; test end crossing midnight
cases.expected: Duration preserved; chosen date/time/zone remain explicit; no negative duration

cases.steps: Empty title, missing time/duration, invalid time, later invitation, ambiguous AM/PM
cases.expected: No invalid insertion; only essential missing questions; optional location is never a blocker

cases.steps: Navigate month boundary, month clamp/leap year, day tabs and deleted tab with keyboard
cases.expected: Focus follows selected date after delayed layout; one logical tab stop; no lost focus

cases.steps: Search rapidly; ArrowDown/Up/Return/Escape; open menu with arrows/typeahead; cycle regions
cases.expected: Delayed autofocus never steals user focus; menus close/restore correctly; no widget movement from menu keys

cases.steps: Type Vietnamese with IME; invoke new/search while editor is open; disable single-key shortcuts
cases.expected: Composition uninterrupted; no replaced draft; modified shortcuts and native text editing work as documented

cases.steps: Complete a task with completed items filtered out; refresh sources while a control is focused
cases.expected: Focus moves to next useful item; stable IDs preserve focus; data persists

cases.steps: Import synthetic image/text/ICS/CSV/JSON/PDF/DOCX; cancel; retry; answer missing-field cards
cases.expected: Local-first extraction; staged inbox; explicit Add ready plans; no incomplete/past/duplicate insertion

cases.steps: Use fixture collision at 19:00, then explicitly correct it to 20:00 and apply
cases.expected: Fixed class unchanged; conflicting plan held until correction; exactly one valid addition

cases.steps: Read public link; require source sign-in; cancel; reopen remembered source; forget
cases.expected: Truthful login state; private cookies remain local; no authenticated content committed or uploaded without consent

cases.steps: Create AppKit widget, drag, keyboard move/resize, open options, remove during pending frame save, relaunch
cases.expected: No resurrected widget; bounds remain on screen; fixed typography with additional content at larger sizes

cases.steps: Provision host/extension; add system widget; resize; Done twice; delete event; midnight; remove widget
cases.expected: Shared store and AppIntent verified; no duplicate completion or resurrected task; host-owned placement remains intact

cases.steps: Share text and image; OCR; review; cancel; retry same draft; oversized/unreadable input
cases.expected: Explicit local read; single-use draft; zero writes until Confirm; no raw text in URL; no background cross-app monitoring

cases.steps: Assistant authorized source -> type -> switch app -> pause -> lock -> forget -> restart
cases.expected: Existing native composer support retained; no stale proposal/save; chat focus preserved until explicit Review

cases.steps: Light/dark, all Vietnamese fixtures, large text, reduced motion/transparency, narrow Mac, small iPhone, iPad split view
cases.expected: Bundled font and correct tokens; opaque readable controls; no clipped actions; 44pt targets; platform fallback works

cases.steps: VoiceOver read/adjust time columns, traverse editor/calendar, activate Confirm and widget Done
cases.expected: Meaningful labels/value announcements, logical focus, no trap or hidden focused item

cases.steps: Weather/maps/Spotify permission, real result, offline, stale cache, disconnect; reminders opt-in and cancel
cases.expected: No fabricated service data; truthful cached/offline state; completion cancels reminder; provider scope stays explicit

cases.steps: Install over previous native build with appointments, sources, partial progress and widgets
cases.expected: IDs/keys/data preserved; backup/restore and concurrent widget writes pass; no storage-mode switch without migration

cases.steps: Inspect archive, bundle resources, entitlements, signatures, architecture; notarize/test DMG or export/test iOS through authorized channel
cases.expected: Actual signed artifacts and hashes recorded; no synthetic profile/private credentials packaged; no release claim from compile alone
